description: Implementation of the class AdbLegacyInterfaceObject, which manages USB interface interactions for Android Debug Bridge (ADB) on Windows, including handle creation, descriptor caching, endpoint management, and serial number retrieval.

classes.name: AdbLegacyInterfaceObject
classes.description: Manages USB interface operations for ADB, including handle creation, descriptor caching, endpoint configuration, and serial number retrieval.

methods.name: CreateHandle
methods.description: Creates a handle for the USB interface, opening the device, caching descriptors, and setting up endpoints.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of the USB device, supporting wide and ANSI string formats.

methods.name: GetEndpointInformation
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific endpoint on the USB interface.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens a specific endpoint by index, converting index to endpoint name and ID.

methods.name: OpenEndpoint
methods.description: Opens an endpoint given its name, ID, index, access type, and sharing mode.

methods.name: CacheUsbDeviceDescriptor
methods.description: Caches the USB device descriptor via IOCTL.

methods.name: CacheUsbConfigurationDescriptor
methods.description: Caches the USB configuration descriptor via IOCTL.

methods.name: CacheUsbInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Caches the USB interface descriptor via IOCTL.
